title: Chester County proposes a 5.29% property tax increase for 2027
summary: Commissioners introduced a preliminary $782.2 million budget on Nov. 18 that would add about $27.30 a year per $100,000 of assessed value, after last year's budget held the rate flat. The final vote is set for Dec. 16 at 10 a.m. at the county building on West Market Street.

title: West Chester Preservation Awards honor restored homes and new carriage houses
summary: The West Chester Downtown Foundation's 15th annual awards recognized the Hanna Darlington house beside the library on North Church Street, a restored 1883 Victorian on Dean Street and new carriage-house units built to match historic blocks. A public mural and a student-curated borough history exhibit were also honored.

title: Hometown Christmas Parade returns Dec. 4 with more marching bands
summary: The chamber's parade steps off at 7 p.m. Friday, Dec. 4, after a 6:30 p.m. lighting of the 28-foot tree at the Historic Chester County Courthouse. Organizers added marching bands this year, and float competitions return.
loc: High and Market streets, West Chester

title: Villa Maria field hockey and Downingtown West girls soccer reach state finals
summary: Villa Maria beat Emmaus 2-1 on a goal with 31 seconds left in double overtime and plays Parkland for the 3A field hockey title Saturday. Downingtown West blanked Downingtown East 1-0 at West Chester East and faces Central Bucks East in Saturday's 4A girls soccer final in Pittsburgh.

title: Spring House at Brandywine apartments sell for $66.3 million
summary: Invesco bought the 212-unit complex on Reisling Lane off Route 202 from Coastal Ridge Real Estate, about $312,500 a unit and 72 percent more than Coastal Ridge paid in 2019. The deal is the latest in a run of large apartment sales and loans across the county.
loc: Reisling Lane off Route 202, West Chester

title: Unionville-Chadds Ford moves its $164 million Patton Middle School replacement to design
summary: The school board voted 7-0 on Nov. 16 to advance the new two-story building into its next design phase. Work would start with tennis courts and parking in 2029, with the school itself built from 2032 and finished by May 2034, pending East Marlborough approval.
loc: Patton Middle School, East Marlborough Township

title: Judge clears Exton Square Mall redevelopment; West Whiteland plans to appeal
summary: A Chester County judge on Nov. 13 overturned the township's 2025 rejection of Abrams Realty's plan to replace most of the mall with homes, shops and offices, keeping Boscov's. Supervisors say they will appeal, while the developer prepares for demolition.

title: West Chester Area Senior Center asks county to keep all six centers funded
summary: A staff member of the borough's senior center urged the county commissioners Tuesday to help find a funding plan that keeps every senior center open. The county's aging office says it has paid for more than 106,000 meals so far this year.

title: West Chester remembers attorney and former commissioner Pat O'Donnell
summary: Pat O'Donnell, a West Chester lawyer for about 50 years and a former Chester County commissioner, died Nov. 11 at 78. He practiced at Gawthrop Greenwood until retiring in 2025 and served 25 years on the Good Fellowship Ambulance board.

title: Christkindlmarkt brings 100-plus vendors to Gay Street Dec. 12
summary: The seventh annual outdoor holiday market fills Gay and Church streets from 11 a.m. to 6 p.m. on Saturday, Dec. 12, with handmade gifts, carolers and music. Santa visits M&T Bank on High Street from 2 to 4 p.m.
loc: Gay and Church streets, West Chester

title: Six holiday weekends start Nov. 27 with store discounts and free street parking
summary: The Greater West Chester Chamber of Commerce expects about 40,000 visitors for its downtown holiday campaign, which opens Black Friday with many of the roughly 180 shops and restaurants offering 20 to 30 percent off and other promotions. On-street parking is free Nov. 27 through 29, and the program runs through New Year's Day.

title: Greek-style coffee shop opens on West Gay Street; 7 Brew drive-thru follows Monday
summary: Brewing Love has opened at 145 W. Gay St., pouring freddos, the iced coffee popular in Greece, along with iced matcha and pastries. Drive-thru chain 7 Brew is set to open at 829 Paoli Pike on Monday, Nov. 16.
